tool.name: transformMetadata

param.name: Source_Metadata
param.dialogReference: Select the source metadata you wish to transform. This could be a standalone record or a dataset with associated metadata.

param.name: Output_Dir
param.dialogReference: Provide a directory where the transformed metadata should be saved.

param.name: Custom_XSLT
param.expression: ArcGIS to FgdcCsdgm | ArcGIS to ISO19115_3 | ArcGIS to ISO19139 | ArcGIS to ISO19139gml32 | EsriIso to ArcGIS | FgdcCsdgm to ArcGIS | ISO19115_3 to ArcGIS | ISO19139 to ArcGIS | ISO19139gml32 to ArcGIS | Custom Transform
param.dialogReference: Select from one of the provided transforms, or choose "Custom Transform" if you have your own XSLT.

param.name: Custom_Transform
param.dialogReference: Provide your own custom xslt if you wish.

tool.summary: In ArcMap Esri provided a geoprocessing tool that could be used to transform metadata between formats, but in ArcGIS Pro that functionality is only available via python scripts. This tool restores that functionality and includes several updated transforms that provide improved handling of ISO records, particularly from the U.S. Census Bureau.
